points.K1: 超过4英尺要查危险气体
points.K6: 荷载、天气、振动加大风险

shots.scene: 欣欣戴安全帽站在围挡外，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a safety helmet stands outside a construction fence and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天十五道题，测测开挖安全知识。
overlay: 开挖与沟槽安全十五问

shots.scene: 一行图标：挖掘机、沟槽、梯子、气体检测仪
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: an excavator, a trench, a ladder and a gas detector. No people.
shots.narration: 选择题和判断题，听题再看答案。

shots.scene: 工地旁一条正在开挖的沟槽，围挡和警示灯
shots.prompt_en: At a work site, a trench is being dug, with fences and warning lights around it.
shots.narration: 工地上正在开挖一条沟槽。

shots.scene: 老李和阿杰坐在工棚里，桌上放着空白答卷
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the young male student sit in a site office with blank answer sheets on the table.
shots.narration: 老李带阿杰做一套开挖测验。

shots.section_title: 超过4英尺要查危险气体
shots.scene: 深沟剖面图，旁边四个选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a deep trench with four blank option cards beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：开挖超过4英尺深时，应该？
overlay: 超过4英尺要查危险气体

shots.section_title: 超过4英尺要查危险气体
shots.scene: 四张卡片：积水、塌方、气体、停工图标
shots.prompt_en: Four cards with icons: a water puddle, a falling wall, a gas cloud and a stop hand. No people.
shots.narration: 积水易干、不易塌、查气体、不能干。

shots.section_title: 超过4英尺要查危险气体
shots.scene: 气体卡片打勾
shots.prompt_en: The gas cloud card gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，要检查有没有危险气体。

shots.scene: 检测仪屏幕上一个氧气图标
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector display showing an oxygen icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：沟内氧含量应在什么范围？

shots.scene: 四张数值卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four blank number cards in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 四个选项，四个不同的范围。

shots.scene: 第一张卡片打勾
shots.prompt_en: The first card gets a green check. No people.

shots.scene: 沟槽紧挨建筑基础和挡土墙
shots.prompt_en: A trench dug right next to a building foundation and a retaining wall. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：基础或挡墙底部以下开挖？

shots.scene: 支撑系统装好，旁边对错两个按钮
shots.prompt_en: A support system installed against the foundation, with true and false buttons beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 除非设了支撑，否则禁止。对还是错？

shots.scene: “对”按钮亮起
shots.prompt_en: The true button lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：正确。

shots.scene: 一条浅沟，旁边量尺
shots.prompt_en: A shallow trench with a measuring stick beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：多浅以内不需要防塌方系统？

shots.scene: 四张深度卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four blank depth cards in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 小于5、8、7、6英尺，四个选项。

shots.scene: 第一张卡片打勾
shots.prompt_en: The first depth card gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，小于5英尺。

shots.scene: 四个图标：管涌、塌方、鼓胀、冲蚀
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: water boiling up, a trench wall collapsing, a bulging wall and eroded edges. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：最常见的土体失稳是哪种？

shots.scene: 塌方图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: The collapsing wall icon gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，塌方。

shots.section_title: 荷载、天气、振动加大风险
shots.scene: 坑边堆土、车辆、雨云、振动波纹
shots.prompt_en: A trench edge with a soil pile, a parked truck, a rain cloud and vibration waves. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：哪些因素增加土体失稳？
overlay: 荷载、天气、振动加大风险

shots.section_title: 荷载、天气、振动加大风险
shots.scene: 三个图标一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three icons get green checks together. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，以上都是。

shots.scene: 老李拿着空白检查表沿沟走
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks along the trench with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 第七题：按美国职业安全卫生标准，

shots.scene: 日历图标和安全帽图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon next to a hard hat icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要有能力的人每天检查开挖现场？

shots.scene: “对”按钮亮起
shots.prompt_en: The true button lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：正确。

shots.scene: 沟里有人和支撑板的剖面图
shots.prompt_en: A trench cross-section with shoring panels and worker icons. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：随时降低沟槽风险，要限制？

shots.scene: 人形图标数字减少，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The number of worker icons in the trench decreases, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，限制沟里的工人人数。

shots.scene: 滑倒、坠落、埋压、绊倒四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: slipping, falling, being buried and tripping. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：工人最大的致死风险是？

shots.scene: 埋压图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: The being-buried icon gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，被埋压卷入。

shots.scene: 检测仪在沟边待命
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector placed ready at the trench edge. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：特定情况下要做气体检测？

shots.scene: “对”按钮亮起
shots.prompt_en: The true button lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：正确。

shots.scene: 长沟剖面，标出深度和长度
shots.prompt_en: A long trench cross-section with depth and length arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一题：12英尺深、150英尺长，

shots.scene: 沟里每隔一段一架梯子，三张卡片
shots.prompt_en: Ladders at intervals along the trench, with three blank option cards. No people.
shots.narration: 进出梯子最少每隔多远设一架？

shots.scene: 欣欣摊手，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shrugs with a question mark icon beside it.
shots.narration: 这一题，原片只读了题，没报答案。

shots.scene: 梯子立在沟里，顶端位置画问号
shots.prompt_en: A ladder stands in a trench with a question mark at its top. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二题：梯子要伸出沟外多少？

shots.scene: 四张卡片：沟顶、沟箱顶、一两档、3英尺
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option cards with ladder icons at different heights. No people.
shots.narration: 到沟顶、到沟箱顶、高一两档、高3英尺。

shots.scene: 梯子顶端高出地面一截，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A ladder top extends well above the ground surface, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，高出沟槽地面3英尺。

shots.scene: 日历和条件变化的雨云图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon and a rain cloud icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三题：有能力的人多久检查一次？

shots.scene: 两个图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Both icons get green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，每天和条件变化时都要查。

shots.scene: 老李看土壁，再用手捏土样
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer looks at the soil wall, then squeezes a soil sample in his hand.
shots.narration: 第十四题：土质分类要依据什么？

shots.scene: 眼睛图标和手图标并列
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon and a hand icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 至少一次目测、一次手工测试？

shots.scene: “对”按钮亮起
shots.prompt_en: The true button lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：正确。

shots.scene: 土块压下、呼吸受阻、没有救援计划三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: heavy soil pressing down, blocked breathing and a blank rescue plan with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 第十五题：开挖事故致死的原因是？

shots.scene: 三个图标一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three icons get green checks together. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，以上都是。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在沟槽剖面图前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a trench cross-section diagram.
shots.narration: 超过4英尺查气体，氧含量19.5%到22%。

shots.scene: 浅沟和量尺图标
shots.prompt_en: A shallow trench icon with a measuring stick. No people.
shots.narration: 小于5英尺不需防塌方，最常见是塌方。

shots.scene: 日历、梯子、人数减少的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a calendar, a ladder and fewer worker icons. No people.
shots.narration: 每天查，限人数，梯子高出3英尺。

shots.scene: 埋压图标
shots.prompt_en: The being-buried icon with three small cause icons. No people.
shots.narration: 最大致死风险是被埋压卷入。

shots.scene: 欣欣在围挡外挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye outside the construction fence.
shots.narration: 开挖十五问到这里，下次见！
